title: Sound
description: Tunes for the buzzer, in RTTTL. Each event names the tune it plays; an empty name means silence.

keys.name: boot_tone
keys.title: Start-up tune
keys.description: Played once the device has started. Empty = silent.

keys.name: button_tone
keys.title: Button tune
keys.description: Played when the knob is pressed. Empty = silent.
